1879097207.name: Rabbit-speech
1879097207.desc: Summons a little rabbit-friend to brighten your day.

1879182839.name: Air Lore
1879182839.desc: Air continually swirls around your target ally, inflicting damage on any who strike it.\n\nCannot be used on self.

conditionalEffects.description: Using a Lore skill will briefly reduce your Incoming Damage

1879198327.name: Friend of Small Hunters (Onyx Lynx)
1879198327.desc: Summons a lynx companion.\n\nThe lynx is a stealthy hunter.

1879208439.name: Treasure Laden Pony
1879208439.desc: A pony laden with the spoils of a treasure hunt!

1879214583.name: Precise Blow
1879214583.desc: A quick attack which deals Light Damage over time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description: Two-length gambits will tier up an effect that improves the damage of your next Spear of Fate.\nAt tier 3, Spear of Fate removes your Mastery cooldowns for a brief moment.

1879219447.name: Improved Essay of Fire
1879219447.desc: A Rune-keeper may compose a terrible essay of burning fury to bring to bear against their foes.

1879234295.name: Luminous Blood Arrow
1879234295.desc: A damaging shot that also restores the Hunter's Morale.\n\nArrows inflict Light damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.
Blood Arrow heals +5% of Max Morale over time.
Blood Arrow heals +10% of Max Morale over time.

1879240695.name: Mounted Strike
1879240695.desc: A simple passing attack that increases attacking strength when successful.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Increases Fervour by 1</rgb>

1879242103.name: Cleanse
1879242103.desc: Remove all CC and provide immunity to CC

1879248375.name: Kill Shot - Light
1879248375.desc: Targeting the most vital areas of an opponent is difficult enough. While mounted it takes increased skill and effort; maybe even a little patience and luck, but when you strike with this skill the results are destructive.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>This skill has a reduced chance to hit unless the trait Shoot to Kill is active.</rgb>

1879252599.name: Mearas-lore
1879252599.desc: One with nature and the elements the Mearas are adepts at using the natural world against their enemies; as students of nature, beasts and hidden lore so too are Lore-masters who study these wild horses.

1879271287.name: Mighty Roar
1879271287.desc: A mighty roar that damages surrounding opponents, this skill is enabled by taking several hits while Unbreakable is active.

conditionalEffects.description: Mighty Roar heals you for 30% of your max morale.

1879274103.name: Snap Shot - Javelin of Deadly Force - Fire
1879274103.desc: With preparation, some Wardens can throw their Javelins with such deadly force that it will pass completely through several bodies.\n\nFor every target hit, you gain a stack of a Ranged Damage and Critical Damage buff.

1879297399.name: Puncturing Blow
1879297399.desc: Folca executes a vicious puncturing spear strike to a single enemy.

1879318135.name: Thrash - Tier 3
1879318135.desc: You maul the enemy with your sharp claws. Subsequent attacks deal more damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Each hit of Thrash increases the damage of the Beorning, stacking up to three times.
Thrash deals extra damage to targets affected by Claw Swipe.

1879319927.name: Instigate
1879319927.desc: You prefer to command the enemies' attention in battle and know how to instigate your opponent, generating threat over time.

1879320183.name: Slam (Dual)
1879320183.desc: Bring down your weapon with great force upon your foe.

1879339127.name: Guide to Henneth Annûn
1879339127.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Henneth Annûn.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

procEffects.description: DNT - Grants the Burglar a crit response effect

1879406583.name: Swarm of Bees
1879406583.desc: Summons a swarm of probably friendly bees to keep you company.

1879409271.name: Call Ausma
1879409271.desc: Blow the horn to summon Ausma to your side.

1879418743.name: Facepaint - Pipe
1879418743.desc: Apply facepaint to your cheek with a pipe pattern.

1879449847.name: Takedown (Dual)
1879449847.desc: Knocks an enemy down for a short duration.

1879467255.name: Caustic Brew
1879467255.desc: A pot filled with a corrosive substance. Creates a pool of acid on the ground that burns through armour and hide alike.

conditionalEffects.description: Haversack skills may reduce your target's Outgoing and Incoming Damage.
Pot skills may increase incoming damage.

1879470583.name: Precise Blade
1879470583.desc: A follow up strike that deals more damage and has a greater chance to critically hit.\n\nEnables Anchored Thrust.

1879491063.name: Sunstone Drakeling
1879491063.desc: Summons a friendly drakeling to accompany you on your adventures.

1879495159.name: Exotic Cheese
1879495159.desc: A crate of fine yet strong smelling cheese. Place this down and see who is adventurous enough to try some.

1879497719.name: Major Pet Command
1879497719.desc: Command your pet to execute a major skill on themselves or their target.

1879506679.name: Spirit
1879506679.desc: Call upon the stallion's spirit to restore the Power of yourself or a fellow.

1879508727.name: Return to Jiret-menêsh
1879508727.desc: You're able to quickly return to Jiret-menêsh in An Shêru in Mûr Ghala. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879520631.name: Mûrai Herding Dog
1879520631.desc: Summons a hard working herding dog to accompany you on your travels.

1879528567.name: Umbral Pall Synergy
1879528567.desc: Devoted to the Umbral Pall, infused by a Synergy, your target expels shadows, damaging nearby enemies and afflicting them with an effect corresponding to the devotion of your most recent attack.
